notes:
Round 54, 57 target places. SIX records filed: PNG, TWN, CUB, ARE, LAO, SGP.

RULED OUT with what was read:
- PAK: fetched profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2024/11/03/govt-proposes-amendments-to-sbp-act/ in full. The finance ministry did draft ~a dozen amendments to the SBP Act and sent them to cabinet, but the article's content is lifting the dual-nationality bar for governor/deputy governors, defining digital currency, a payments subsidiary and board meeting mechanics. The article explicitly does not say autonomy is reduced, and the dual-nationality item is an appointment matter, which this layer excludes. Earlier search also showed the direction of travel in Pakistan is the opposite of this row (SBP Amendment Act 2021 and 2025 IMF pressure both push toward MORE independence). No record.
- LTU: searched twice. Everything returned is the 2023-2025 'temporary solidarity contribution' windfall tax on COMMERCIAL banks, with ECB and the Bank of Lithuania commenting on it as supervisors. That is the state taxing banks, not the state acting on its own central bank. No ECB CON opinion on a Lithuanian draft touching Bank of Lithuania independence surfaced. No record.
- MLT: searched for an ECB opinion on Maltese central bank legislation and fetched the one ecb.europa.eu/ecb/legal/pdf/ hit (mt_part-2017-591203v1.pdf). It turned out to be CON/2018/20 of 11 April 2018 on the EU-level European Monetary Fund proposal in Maltese translation, with no mention of the Central Bank of Malta. No record.
- ARM: searched the National Assembly / central bank axis. Only hit of the right shape is armenpress 'Lawmaker sees need for raising Central Bank's accountability', which is a single MP characterising the relationship with no dated act by any organ of the state. Excluded as characterisation. No record.
- RWA: searched the Office of the Auditor General and Public Accounts Committee against the National Bank of Rwanda. The OAG annual reports to Parliament surfaced, but no special audit, inquiry or finding directed AT the central bank. Nothing filed; the OAG site (oag.gov.rw) annual reports would need a page-by-page hand check.
- SAU: searched for the Saudi Central Bank Law text; the only full-text hit (qanoniah.com) returned a client error on fetch. The SAMA rulebook hits returned are the Banking Control Law, which governs commercial banks, not SAMA's own subordination. NEEDS A HAND CHECK: https://rulebook.sama.gov.sa/en/node/4841 (Saudi Central Bank Law) and https://sama.gov.sa/en-US/About/Documents/SAMA_EN_1293_VER1.pdf.
- SYR: the statute route looked promising (Law 23/2002 and the Monetary and Credit Council chaired from the executive) but the one dated-episode hit, an enabbaladi.net report of a presidential decree constituting the Monetary and Credit Council, returned a client error on fetch. NEEDS A HAND CHECK: https://www.enabbaladi.net/429162/ and the Arabic law PDFs at cb.gov.sy/downloads/files/ (1723708833.PDF, 1723706930.PDF).
- VNM: the State Bank's own English page (sbv.gov.vn/en/monetary-policy-decision-making-authority-and-monetary-policy-tools) confirms the arrangement in words - the National Assembly determines the annual inflation target, the Government submits it, and 'The Prime Minister, the SBV Governor determine the use of tools and measures' - but the page gives NEITHER the law number NOR any date, and a statutory record needs the date the law came into force. Not filed rather than guess the date. NEEDS A HAND CHECK for the commencement date: https://english.luatvietnam.vn/tai-chinh/consolidated-text-25-vbhn-vpqh-2022-of-the-law-on-the-state-bank-of-vietnam-248582-d5.html

records.kind: central bank law put under government-ordered review
records.summary: Treasurer Ian Ling-Stuckey, acting in consultation with the Prime Minister and the Ministerial Economic Committee of the National Executive Council, issued terms of reference dated 13 May 2021 for a review of the Central Banking Act 2000 that was directed to examine whether the Bank of Papua New Guinea Governor should keep his sole power to determine monetary policy under section 10, and to reassess the governance arrangements and the length of senior management terms at the Bank.
records.source_title: Review of the Central Banking Act 2000, Phase One Report - Annex 1: Terms of Reference

records.kind: statutory arrangement placing the central bank under the cabinet
records.summary: Under the revised Central Bank of China Act promulgated on 8 November 1979, the central bank sits as a state bank and an agency under the Executive Yuan, Taiwan's cabinet, rather than standing outside the executive branch; the bank's own official history records that it has been under the Executive Yuan since that reorganisation. This is a standing arrangement with no end date and no episode attached.
records.source_title: Brief History - Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)

records.kind: statutory arrangement removing the bank's control of monetary policy
records.summary: Decree-Law 361 of 2018, issued by Cuba's Council of State and published in the Gaceta Oficial on 12 October 2018 in place of Decree-Law 172 of 1997, strips the Banco Central de Cuba of autonomy over monetary policy by requiring the bank to design monetary policy in coordination with the government's fiscal and macroeconomic objectives under an annual policy agreement signed by ministers. This is a standing arrangement with no end date and no episode attached.
records.source_title: New Financial Regulations in Cuba: Less Autonomy for Monetary Policy and More Space for Foreign Capital and Microcredit

records.kind: statutory arrangement giving the cabinet power over the central bank
records.summary: Decretal Federal Law No. 14 of 2018 places the Central Bank of the UAE under the federal Cabinet in several respects at once: board members are appointed by federal decree on the Cabinet's recommendation (Article 11) and their membership may be terminated by federal decree on the Cabinet's approval (Article 14), the exchange rate regime is set only on a board proposal with Cabinet approval (Article 31), and the bank may not withdraw a currency denomination from circulation without Cabinet approval (Article 59). This is a standing arrangement with no end date and no episode attached.
records.source_title: Decretal Federal Law No. (14) of 2018 Regarding the Central Bank and Organization of Financial Institutions and Activities

records.kind: statutory arrangement putting the government in charge of the central bank
records.summary: The Law on the National Bank of the Lao PDR, adopted by the National Assembly on 14 October 1995 and in force from the promulgating Presidential Decree of 26 October 1995, makes a Deputy Prime Minister the chair of the central bank's Board of Management (Article 11), has the Prime Minister appoint and remove board members (Article 12), and requires the Governor to submit monetary policy to the Government for the Government to decide and proclaim (Article 19). This is a standing arrangement with no end date and no episode attached.
records.source_title: Law on the National Bank of the Lao PDR, No. 05/95/NA (Lao Official Gazette)

records.kind: statutory arrangement giving a minister the final word over the central bank
records.summary: The Monetary Authority of Singapore Act, in operation since 26 December 1970, lets a primary dealer appeal certain decisions of the Monetary Authority to the Minister, whose decision is final (section 149), requires the Authority to administer the Financial Sector Development Fund subject to the directions of the Minister (section 127), obliges the board to give the Minister whatever information he requires (section 7), and lets the President refuse or revoke the appointment of the chairperson, directors or managing director in his own discretion (section 11A). This is a standing arrangement with no end date and no episode attached.
records.source_title: Monetary Authority of Singapore Act 1970 (consolidated text)
